xmldoc.short_description: True when the AI assistant UI is enabled.

description.p: nelson.ai.isAssistantEnabled returns true when the AI assistant user interface is enabled for the running session, and false otherwise.

The assistant panels (the console dock, the editor and notebook helpers, and the NFlow build pane) are hidden by default. They appear only when the environment variable NELSON_ASSISTANT_AI is set to 1 before Nelson starts.

The nelson.ai.* functions stay callable from the console and scripts whether or not the user interface is enabled. The Qt, web and NFlow front-ends read the same environment variable, so this function is the scriptable mirror of that gate.

example_item.example_item_description: Check whether the assistant user interface is enabled.
